points.name: Polyp
points.line: A tiny stalk stuck to a rock, with a mouth and tentacles on top. Many jellies start life like this.

points.name: Sea turtle
points.line: A reptile that lives in the ocean and comes ashore only to lay eggs.

points.name: Singapore
points.line: An island city and country at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula.

links.why: The polyp buds off tiny young jellies that grow into adults.
A jelly's body is mostly water and it can only live in it.
